title: Sprout Kids Bulletin — Spring
summary: Kickoff, the Rooted Kids guide and the harvest party — one issue for the whole season.

items: 6 Sep — Sprout Kids Kickoff, 10am in the kids hall
Term theme — Habits: the Rooted Kids guide has a daily verse with its own little 'growing step'
Verse hunt — every week the guide hides a verse to find

blocks.text: A seed is not in a hurry

Kids' study habits grow like seeds: a little water every day beats a flood once a month. This Spring the Rooted Kids guide gives your child one tiny growing step a day — a verse, a thought, a 'do this today'. Read it with them, same time, same chair. By the harvest party, the roots will be deeper than you think.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart.
